statement: Computed float64 values before display rounding (the CSV files round to six significant figures). This preserves computational precision only: it is not higher experimental accuracy and does not recover precision lost in the float32 coordinates held by the Cα adapter. A missing value is null with its status; it is never zero.

altloc_sensitivity.status: not applicable: no alternate locations at the mapped Cα atoms

provenance.coordinate_precision: float32 in the Cα adapter; values computed in float64 from them
